title.zh: AliExpress：非法、危险及仿冒商品风险
title.en: AliExpress: illegal, unsafe & counterfeit product risks

evidence_snapshot.zh: 正式程序、2025 年绑定承诺与 2026 年罚款决定，整改执行证据持续跟踪。
evidence_snapshot.en: Formal proceedings, binding commitments in 2025 and the 2026 fine decision; remediation evidence remains under review.

stage.zh: 不合规决定 / 承诺整改

deadline.zh: 执行罚款决定并持续提交承诺实施证据
deadline.en: Implement the decision and continue commitment evidence reporting

status.zh: 罚款决定已作出；承诺与整改执行中
status.en: Fine decision issued; commitments and remediation in progress

summary.zh: 欧委会先后评估 AliExpress 的风险治理、内容举报、广告与推荐透明度、商家可追溯性及研究者访问，最终就非法、危险或仿冒商品风险作出 5.5 亿欧元罚款决定。
summary.en: The Commission assessed AliExpress on risk governance, notice and action, ad and recommender transparency, trader traceability and researcher access before issuing a €550 million decision on illegal, unsafe and counterfeit-product risks.

businessImpact.zh: 影响商家核验、非法商品下架、广告库、推荐系统、研究者 API 与监测受托人报告。
businessImpact.en: Impacts seller verification, illegal-product controls, the ad repository, recommender systems, researcher APIs and monitoring-trustee reporting.

nextAction.zh: 按承诺清单核验非法商品、商家追溯与研究者访问证据
nextAction.en: Verify illegal-product, trader-traceability and researcher-access evidence against the commitment list

keyPoints.zh: 2024 年 3 月启动正式程序，覆盖多个 DSA 义务组。
keyPoints.en: Formal proceedings opened in March 2024 across several DSA obligation groups.

keyPoints.zh: 2025 年 6 月承诺被欧委会作出绑定，承诺实施期为五年。
keyPoints.en: Commitments became binding in June 2025 with a five-year implementation period.

keyPoints.zh: 2026 年 7 月因非法、危险或仿冒商品风险被罚款 €5.5 亿。
keyPoints.en: A €550 million fine was issued in July 2026 over illegal, unsafe and counterfeit-product risks.

description.zh: 欧委会认定 AliExpress 未充分评估和降低非法、危险及仿冒商品传播风险。
description.en: The Commission found that AliExpress failed to diligently assess and mitigate risks from illegal, unsafe and counterfeit products.

description.zh: 承诺覆盖隐藏链接、举报机制、广告与推荐透明度、商家追溯和研究者数据访问。
description.en: Commitments covered hidden links, notice and action, ad and recommender transparency, trader traceability and researcher access.

description.zh: 欧委会围绕风险治理、内容审核、投诉机制、广告、推荐、商家追溯与数据访问启动程序。
description.en: The Commission opened proceedings into risk governance, content moderation, complaints, ads, recommender systems, trader traceability and data access.

label.zh: 欧委会：AliExpress 罚款 €5.5 亿

stage.zh: 不合规决定 / 行动计划

summary.zh: 欧委会围绕 Temu 的非法商品、上瘾式设计、推荐系统和研究者数据访问启动程序，并因风险评估不足作出 2 亿欧元罚款决定。
summary.en: The Commission opened proceedings into illegal products, addictive design, recommender systems and researcher access, then issued a €200 million fine for inadequate risk assessment.

businessImpact.zh: 影响商品合规、推荐系统参数披露、非画像推荐选项、研究者访问及临时风险评估。
businessImpact.en: Impacts product compliance, recommender-parameter disclosure, non-profiling options, researcher access and interim risk assessment.

nextAction.zh: 核验行动计划五项措施和 11 月临时风险评估证据

keyPoints.zh: 2026 年 5 月因未充分评估非法商品系统性风险被罚款 €2 亿。
keyPoints.en: A €200 million fine was issued in May 2026 for inadequate assessment of systemic risks from illegal products.

keyPoints.zh: 2026 年 10 月行动计划聚焦平台风险分析、指标、内容审核与推荐系统放大风险。

summary.en: The Commission preliminarily found that Meta did not adequately assess risks from addictive design on Instagram and Facebook to users, minors and vulnerable adults.

businessImpact.zh: 影响产品设计评估、未成年人保护、推荐系统治理、推送通知和健康风险缓解证据。

keyPoints.zh: 欧委会认为现有缓解措施未能有效处理身心健康风险。
